page_title: DAR 0-2 LEV | Darmstadt v Bayer Leverkusen 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Noah Mbamba (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Adam Hlozek.

90+3' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' A dangerous looking corner kick from Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is cleared to safety by the defence.
88' Here comes a substitution. Granit Xhaka is given a rest as he is replaced by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen).
86' Bayer Leverkusen string together a series of short passes.
84' 7:17 – the total goal attempt statistics.
81' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to substitute Bartol Franjic and he is replaced by Andreas Muller (Darmstadt).
81' Torsten Lieberknecht is forced to make a change. Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Christoph Klarer.
79' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
78' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul after Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) hacks down one of his opponents.
78' The attendance for today's match is 17810.
77' Substitution. Florian Wirtz will be replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
76' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
75' It should have been a goal! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
74' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
73' A pass lands at the feet of Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
71' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matej Maglica (Darmstadt).
68' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Fabian Holland walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt).
67' A substitution has been made. Oscar Vilhelmsson is replaced by Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt).
66' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
65' Gerrit Holtmann is being substituted because of an injury. Torsten Lieberknecht sends Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) on the pitch.
64' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
63' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
63' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
59' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
57' Darmstadt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
54' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
52' 0 - 2 It's 0:2! Florian Wirtz feeds Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top of the net.
51' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is adjudged offside.
50' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
50' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
49' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
47' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' A pass travels right across the box to Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper into the roof of the net, but Lukas Hradecky denies him with a decent save.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Marcel Schuhen easily deals with the threat.
43' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
43' Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
43' The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
42' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Marcel Schuhen stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
41' A fine pass finds Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marcel Schuhen reacts superbly to deny him.
40' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' The game is interrupted now, Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

39' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
39' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
38' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
36' The referee blows his whistle, Darmstadt are awarded a corner kick.

33' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Alejandro Grimaldo and planted his close-range header into the middle of the goal. Marcel Schuhen was helpless.
32' The goalkeeper dives to deny Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
32' A pass into the penalty area from Josip Stanisic (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
29' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) trips an opposition player and Tobias Reichel signals a foul.
28' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
28' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
25' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
25' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
24' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Lukas Hradecky easily deals with the threat.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:2.

20' Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
20' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
19' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. Darmstadt earn a corner.
16' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
14' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
9' Bayer Leverkusen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
7' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
4' Some neat passing and movement from Darmstadt as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' Gerrit Holtmann (Darmstadt) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
